title: The Name of the Wind
author: Patrick Rothfuss
description: The tale of Kvothe, a mythic figure who must piece together his extraordinary past.

title: Dune
author: Frank Herbert
description: A desert planet holds the most valuable substance in the universe and becomes the stage for epic conflict.

title: Sapiens
author: Yuval Noah Harari
description: A brief history of humankind tracing the evolution of homo sapiens from the Stone Age to the modern era.

title: The Left Hand of Darkness
author: Ursula K. Le Guin
description: An envoy from Earth visits a planet whose inhabitants have no fixed gender.

title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
author: Daniel Kahneman
description: A comprehensive look at two systems of thought and how they shape our judgments and decisions.

title: Never Let Me Go
author: Kazuo Ishiguro
description: Students at an idyllic English boarding school slowly uncover the shocking purpose of their upbringing.

title: The Fifth Season
author: N.K. Jemisin
description: A world that periodically suffers catastrophic climate events called fifth seasons, and one woman's quest.

title: Meditations
author: Marcus Aurelius
description: Personal writings of the Roman Emperor providing advice on Stoic philosophy and self-improvement.

title: The Three-Body Problem
author: Liu Cixin
description: A secret military project sends signals into space and an alien civilization on the verge of collapse plans to invade Earth.

title: Lincoln in the Bardo
author: George Saunders
description: President Lincoln visits his son's tomb where the spirits of the dead linger in a ghostly purgatory.

title: Atomic Habits
author: James Clear
description: A practical guide to building good habits and breaking bad ones through small, incremental changes.

title: The Remains of the Day
author: Kazuo Ishiguro
description: A butler reflects on his years of service and his emotional repression in post-war England.

title: Hyperion
author: Dan Simmons
description: Seven pilgrims travel to the distant world of Hyperion, each carrying a terrible secret.

title: A Short History of Nearly Everything
author: Bill Bryson
description: An accessible survey of human scientific knowledge, from the Big Bang to the rise of civilization.

title: The Power Broker
author: Robert Caro
description: A biography of Robert Moses and his extraordinary influence over New York City's development.

title: Piranesi
author: Susanna Clarke
description: A man lives alone in a vast house filled with infinite halls, statues, and flooding tides.

title: The Overstory
author: Richard Powers
description: Nine Americans whose lives are linked by their connections to trees come together to help save the world's forests.

title: Being Mortal
author: Atul Gawande
description: A surgeon examines how medicine fails the elderly and dying and how we can do better.

title: The Buried Giant
author: Kazuo Ishiguro
description: An elderly couple journey across post-Arthurian Britain to find their son, amid a mysterious collective amnesia.

title: Guns, Germs, and Steel
author: Jared Diamond
description: An exploration of why some civilizations came to dominate others through environmental and geographic factors.
